editorial: We did not preserve a complete Brazil expense total.

Some reference points from our trip: feijoada in Copacabana cost roughly USD8, while a so-called private Iguacu transfer/tour cost USD65 per person and felt poor value. Foz was notably expensive for a small city because the tourism economy is concentrated around the falls.
The Amazon excursion and repeated domestic flights are the structural costs. Everyday food can still be reasonable.

alternatives.title: What if we had a bigger budget?
editorial: We'd upgrade the Amazon experience and reduce logistical friction: better flight times, more nights in each base and perhaps a premium stay with a strong naturalist programme.

alternatives.title: What if we had a smaller budget?
editorial: Cut a destination rather than cheapening every day. Rio plus Iguacu is a coherent shorter trip; Rio plus the Amazon is a more distinctive one. Four domestic hops on a shoestring is false economy.

title: What it's Going to Cost
